IRON YARD -- one-time owner-authorized PUBLIC Roblox v57 update, 13 November 2026.

Target ONLY the already PUBLIC creator-owned IRON YARD Roblox experience.
Require a fresh green Rojo CI build for this exact authorization commit,
and independently verify universe, root place, owner and PUBLIC visibility.
Do not create a separate private experience or change any visibility.

Purpose: publish the three original industrial PBR world materials:
freight_steel, warehouse_steel, yard_asphalt. All four 1K channels
(ColorMap, NormalMap, RoughnessMap, MetalnessMap) per material have
owner-approved Roblox Image IDs in src/shared/WorldPbrAssetIds.luau.
All twelve were approved in original upload run 43412637168, then
reverified WITHOUT re-upload and committed to main by owner recovery
run 43414519380. Source textures are pinned to successful generator
run 43389183645, source commit 903deaafacc29011972b86cbea117bd52d211b76.

VANGUARD four operator Model IDs and ten weapon Model IDs remain intact.
MaterialVariants are added only for the three allowed world surface
names and base Roblox materials; the collision/hitbox geometry, damage,
duel mode, progression and movement code are unchanged. Native materials
remain the fallback if registration cannot complete. The owner PERF
panel reports world PBR CONFIGURED/FALLBACK; this does not claim that

Authorize exactly one guarded PUBLIC place update, after green CI and
